subject: Coordinating Alex Rivera — full loop slot weave + debrief owners
messages:
From: Recruiter - HiringPartner Inc <recruiter@hiringpartner.com>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 7 Aug 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Candidate availability — Alex Rivera (FinApps)

Hi Sean / Laura / Marissa,

Quick intro: Alex Rivera (ex-product at ScaleOps) is excited about the Senior Infra PM role at FinApps. Sophie (hiring manager) would like a virtual full loop next Tuesday. Alex can do a 4-slot block between 10:00–14:00 PT.

I attached Alex's resume and a proposed slot matrix (v1). Can you confirm evaluator availability and who will own the debrief? Sophie prefers a 30-min hiring manager deep-dive at the end.

Attaching: Alex_Rivera_Resume.pdf, slot_matrix_v2.xlsx

Best,
Maya 
Recruiter — HiringPartner Inc
recruiter@hiringpartner.com
From: sean_gallagher@redwood.com
To: Recruiter - HiringPartner Inc <recruiter@hiringpartner.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 7 Aug 2029 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Candidate availability — Alex Rivera (FinApps)

Thanks, Maya — looping in internal owners. A few constraints from our side:
- We should avoid putting two infra-focused interviewers back-to-back; prefer an infra-design -> systems-scaling -> leadership flow.
- Laura can cover systems-scaling but is booked 11:00–11:30 PT.
- Kimberly can cover leadership/final panel and will own the debrief if Sophie is unavailable.

Proposed 4-slot weave (all PT):
1) 10:00–10:35 — Product sense (Marissa)
2) 10:45–11:25 — Infra design (Karthik)
3) 11:40–12:20 — Systems scaling (Laura)
4) 13:00–13:40 — Hiring manager deep-dive (Sophie)

I left a 20–40 minute buffer between slots for short breaks and notes. Can you check if Sophie can do 13:00 PT and confirm the candidate accepts the gap? Also, who will write the scorecard? I can take primary notes for infra and Kimberly will collate final feedback if needed.

- Sean
Senior TA Partner, Redwood Inference
From: Recruiter - HiringPartner Inc <recruiter@hiringpartner.com>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 7 Aug 2029 11:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Candidate availability — Alex Rivera (FinApps)

Sean — quick update: Sophie confirmed 13:00 PT. Alex is fine with the break and prefers the later HM slot. He also asked if we can keep the HM block to 35 minutes to cover culture + compensation signals.

He also flagged that he has a hard stop at 14:30 PT for another commitment.

I'll send a calendar invite once you confirm the final owners and the debrief plan.

Thanks,
Maya
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 7 Aug 2029 13:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Candidate availability — Alex Rivera (FinApps)

Happy to take systems scaling (11:40–12:20). Notes on evaluation and debrief ownership:
- I will capture tech risks and performance trade-offs on the shared scorecard.
- Marissa: please own the product sense rubric and 1–2 prompting questions that test trade-offs vs. user metrics.
- Karthik: if you can take infra design at 10:45, please add at least one whiteboard prompt and note expected depth for a senior PM.
- Kimberly: if Sophie needs to step out, you own the HM follow-up and you will finalize the consolidated feedback in Greenhouse.

I'll upload panel_briefing_notes.docx with the prompts and an updated slot_matrix_v2.xlsx (minor timing shifts).

Laura Bennett
Engineering Hiring Lead, Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: Recruiter - HiringPartner Inc <recruiter@hiringpartner.com>, Sophie Chen <sophie.chen@finapps.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Aug 2029 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Final — Alex Rivera virtual full loop (10:00–13:40 PT)

All — locking this in and sending invites:
- 10:00–10:35 PT — Product sense (Marissa) — Zoom link in invite
- 10:45–11:25 PT — Infra design (Karthik) — whiteboard + shared doc
- 11:40–12:20 PT — Systems scaling (Laura) — bring perf tradeoff examples
- 13:00–13:35 PT — Hiring manager deep-dive (Sophie) — will cover role fit + next steps

Buffers: 10:35–10:45 and 11:25–11:40 for breaks / notes. Candidate has a hard stop at 14:30 PT — we'll keep HM to 35 minutes.

Debrief plan: Kimberly will compile the final feedback in Greenhouse within 24 hours. Sean will be point for follow-ups and offer timing.

Attachments: panel_briefing_notes.docx, slot_matrix_v2.xlsx

Marissa Cole
Product Hiring Partner, Redwood Inference
